svg.aria-label: Pundoku app icon, direction D5 The Carry, tinted mono map
svg.title: Pundoku — D5 «Унос» — tinted / mono map
svg.desc: Luminance map iOS tints, not a finished icon. The carried cell is full white and the field is grey, so the idea survives the mono conversion without hand-inverting anything (that was round 2's D3 problem).
